scopeLimits: Cache 400 RPS is tested arrival rate, not maximum capacity or 400 concurrent users; hot 50/50 homepage plus one fixed detail. 10000-course fixture and 5000 tokens do not imply distinct cache keys or concurrent users.

Cache latency is client HTTP roundtrip including response parsing/content validation on same-host Docker bridge. SQL counters count catalog JDBC invocations; shared cache counters count first read attempts only, excluding authentication and lock/recheck traffic.
Cache percentiles are median and min/max of three per-run percentiles, not pooled quantiles. Startup, warmup, calibrations and interrupted directories are excluded.
Cold: 100/300 gate-released tasks across two instances, ten rounds each after L1 TTL and exact shared key deletion; no measured unlocked baseline or burst CPU peak.
Trial 80 means new logical users/s plus 20 percent extra same-ID HTTP retries; monitoring GETs add traffic. HTTP 202 is durable admission, not final success.
Trial TPS uses order timestamp offset [5,25) seconds from first DB claim, three repeats. Orders may cross window boundaries; it is observed window throughput, not maximum capacity.
Trial claim-to-order latency uses immutable MySQL created_at inside transactions, not commit acknowledgment, SQL execution time, or full HTTP/network latency.
Zero oversell/duplicate observed only in finite free-trial campaigns. No paid orders, forced broker redelivery or production availability established.
TSV exports join claims to orders; orphan orders not joinable to a claim cannot be independently counted from these exports alone.
Services/load generators share a Windows/WSL physical host; no production multi-host scalability claim.

checkedScriptInterpretation.summarize.py: Per-run P95 median/min/max, sum of measurement SQL, explicit catalog-only metric scope; trial totals across repetitions and separate HTTP acceptance/MySQL timestamps. All reported backend values agree with independent raw scan.
checkedScriptInterpretation.plot_evidence.py: Cache median of three run P95s and range; trial delay 1000 vs 100 ms with unchanged batch/build/generator; 80 new logical users/s plus 20% additional replays; TPS [5,25) seconds and in-transaction timestamp limitations explicitly labeled.
checkedScriptInterpretation.optionalLabelPrecision: For standalone cache figure/caption, add client roundtrip including content validation. Existing HTTP P95 label is not numerically incorrect.

reproductionConditions.host: Intel i9-14900HX / 31.6 GiB / Windows 11 + WSL Docker; same physical machine
reproductionConditions.backend: One backend, 4 CPU / 1536 MiB, heap 1024 MiB; cold phase two backend instances
reproductionConditions.catalog: 10000 courses; authenticated 50% first course page and 50% one fixed detail; 5000 actor session tokens; 400 offered RPS, 30-second warmup then 180-second measurement, 3 repetitions per db/redis/two-level mode; startup 100 and 300 RPS for 10s each excluded
reproductionConditions.cacheGenerator: Linux Docker bridge; Python 3.13.15/httpx 0.28.1; 2 CPU / 768 MiB; max inflight 128, max keepalive 32; native /tmp outputs copied after completion
reproductionConditions.cold: Two instances same benchmark cache namespace; wait 10.5 seconds for L1 TTL then exact shared detail-key deletion; 100/300 scheduled tasks, 10 rounds each, balanced instance routes
reproductionConditions.trial: Windows Python 3.13.9 stdlib HTTP threads, concurrency 128; batch 30; fixed delay 1000 ms baseline vs 100 ms optimized; rates 5/20/40/80 new users/s for 30 seconds, 3 repeats each with 10000 seats; plus 1000 users at 100/s for 100 seats, 3 repeats; fresh campaigns
reproductionConditions.trialMonitoring: Same monitor configuration across groups: max aggregate actor polling 50 GET/s, up to 32 concurrent pollers, one second minimum per receipt, reconciliation at most 1/s; extra GET traffic is not included in POST attempts
reproductionConditions.trialRng: Fixed random seed 20261001 chooses floor(users*0.2) actors for one same-ID retry each
